notes: Every rate the student mind uses, in one auditable table (design §3b). Initial values are order-of-magnitude placements from the learning-science directions cited in the design doc (testing > generation > reading; spacing bonus; Ebbinghaus-style decay). P3 psychometric anchoring tunes NUMBERS here; logic never hides in prompts. The compiler team never edits this file in the same change that improves a KPI it feeds (charter §10.4).

contamination.note: P2 (design 3d): an unrepaired misconception on a PREREQUISITE corrupts exposure credit downstream.

genesis.note: P2 (design 3b): ungrounded material can seed a documented misconception on first exposure. Probability scales with (1 - lesson grounded signal) and susceptibility.
